topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I stepped out to the driveway, the air crisp and carrying the scent of rain. The spot where my car had been was now a patch of dewy grass, as if the vehicle itself had been recalled into the earth. No tow truck tracks, no sign of disturbance—just an empty space under a flowering tree. I glanced up at the sky, where a single cloud drifted lazily, and smiled. Something felt right about the change, like the universe had rearranged itself for a reason only it understood. I’ll walk to the garage today, I thought, and maybe pick up a few peonies along the way.
